criteria.criterion: A unit-test fixture whose name does not correspond to a type that exists in the solution fails the build, reported at error severity.
criteria.plannedImplementation: Add the CI0019 analyzer to identify NUnit unit fixtures and resolve the type-name portion of each fixture against the compilation's solution-owned symbols, reporting an error when it is absent.
criteria.plannedVerification: TestFixtureSourceTypeAnalyzerCriterion1Tests supplies a uniquely named NUnit fixture with no matching declaration and expects one CI0019 compiler error on the fixture identifier.

criteria.criterion: A fixture named after a type that exists only outside the solution — a framework or library type — is still reported, because it does not name a type this solution owns.
criteria.plannedImplementation: Resolve candidate fixture names against source declarations belonging to the current compilation rather than accepting metadata symbols such as System.String.
criteria.plannedVerification: TestFixtureSourceTypeAnalyzerCriterion2Tests uses StringTests without a solution String declaration and expects CI0019, proving a framework symbol does not satisfy ownership.

criteria.criterion: Test fixtures that are not unit-test fixtures are unaffected, since they legitimately do not mirror a single type.
criteria.plannedImplementation: Restrict analysis to the unit-test fixture marker and leave other fixture attributes unreported.
criteria.plannedVerification: TestFixtureSourceTypeAnalyzerCriterion3Tests provides a uniquely named fixture with a non-unit IntegrationFixture attribute and expects no diagnostics.

criteria.criterion: The new rule uses a diagnostic identifier that does not collide with any identifier already in use by any template.
criteria.plannedImplementation: Publish the new analyzer under CI0019 consistently across all four template copies.
criteria.plannedVerification: TestFixtureSourceTypeAnalyzerCriterion4Tests asserts the analyzer identifier is exactly CI0019 and is absent from the existing CI0001 through CI0018 identifiers.

criteria.criterion: After the change, a project freshly scaffolded from any template builds clean — no placeholder fixture is left that the new rule rejects.
criteria.plannedImplementation: Replace each template's placeholder SmokeTests fixture with a fixture whose name mirrors the existing AssemblyMarker type, and include the analyzer in every template's analyzer project.
criteria.plannedVerification: TestFixtureSourceTypeAnalyzerCriterion5Tests checks all four template unit SmokeTests paths contain AssemblyMarkerTests and no longer contain the placeholder SmokeTests fixture; the implementation pass must additionally satisfy the scaffold build gate.

criteria.criterion: The shared guardrail suite remains identical across the templates that share it, so the drift gate passes.
criteria.plannedImplementation: Apply the same analyzer and corresponding shared analyzer-suite changes to cli, etl-api, mcp, and durable, differing only in root namespace.
criteria.plannedVerification: TestFixtureSourceTypeAnalyzerCriterion6Tests applies the existing analyzer-drift gate's shared-file and root-namespace normalization to the four template suites and asserts all normalized shared files are equal.
